description: A refused assessment. Deliberately not a completed assessment with empty fields: different causes must not collapse into one generic empty result, so the code is a closed enumeration and every refusal names one. The document carries no input values and no case content - a refusal is logged, and a log holding a phenotype profile or a clinical sentence is a disclosure waiting to happen. additionalProperties is false throughout, which is where the boundary is actually enforced: a dose, a recommendation, a preferred or safer flag, a suitability score, a ranking, a treatment or a rendered sentence cannot be attached to any of these documents by anything downstream, because the schema refuses every property it does not name. WP-14 calculates structured facts; WP-15 renders them.
title: PGx assessment failure
